An '''individual''' served as the CEO of [[House Salaktori]], the preeminent members house of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]]. The CEO personally selected all [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] who were allowed to join the house as all Salaktori CEO's did. Amongst those this CEO selected was the [[Tarc]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter [[Fascyn]], whom was active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
